novel_features.name: Preprint-to-Publication Tracker
novel_features.description: Track preprints through their lifecycle from posting to peer-reviewed publication, with time-to-publication metrics
novel_features.rationale: Requires persistent cross-session tracking of PPR source records and their HAS_PUBLISHED_VERSION status changes
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to monitor whether preprints in a research area have been peer-reviewed and published

novel_features.name: Annotation Relation Miner
novel_features.description: Build a knowledge graph of gene-disease-chemical relationships from text-mined annotations across papers
novel_features.rationale: Chains three annotation API endpoints into a structured co-occurrence store that no other tool assembles
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs structured gene-disease or drug-target relationships extracted from literature

novel_features.name: Citation Network Builder
novel_features.description: Recursively walk citations and references to build a navigable citation graph in local SQLite
novel_features.rationale: Requires persistent graph storage across recursive API calls that stateless wrappers cannot maintain
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to find bridge papers, citation clusters, or influential works in a research area

novel_features.name: Systematic Review Workbench
novel_features.description: Automate PRISMA systematic review workflow with cross-source deduplication across MED, PMC, and PPR
novel_features.rationale: Requires deduplicating the same article across multiple Europe PMC sources using DOI/PMID/PMCID matching
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent is helping prepare a systematic review and needs PRISMA-compliant identification and deduplication

novel_features.name: Full-Text Section Miner
novel_features.description: Search within specific article sections (Methods, Results, Discussion) and extract section-filtered annotations
novel_features.rationale: Combines Europe PMC's unique section-level search fields with section-filtered annotation API queries
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to find how a technique is used in practice (Methods) vs what it found (Results)

novel_features.name: Grant Impact Dashboard
novel_features.description: Aggregate grant-linked publications with citation counts, OA compliance rates, and second-order citation impact
novel_features.rationale: Combines GRANT_ID/GRANT_AGENCY search fields with citation traversal and source-profile breakdown
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent is assessing research impact for a funding body or grant review

novel_features.name: Preprint Server Intelligence
novel_features.description: Monitor preprint servers by topic, tracking citation velocity and time-to-publication trends
novel_features.rationale: Requires longitudinal PPR source monitoring with stored citation counts and publication status snapshots
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs early-warning signals about emerging research trends before peer review

novel_features.name: Canonical ID Resolver
novel_features.description: Resolve any identifier (DOI, PMID, PMCID, PPR ID) to all other identifiers and deduplicate mixed-format ID lists
novel_features.rationale: Uses the article lookup endpoint with resultType=core to extract the full identifier set and stores canonical mappings
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent has collected papers from multiple databases and needs to remove duplicates that differ only in ID scheme

narrative.headline: Every Europe PMC endpoint, plus preprint tracking, citation graphs, and text-mined annotation mining no other tool offers
narrative.value_prop: Search, cite-track, and mine annotations across PubMed, preprints, European patents, and more. Sync results to a local SQLite store for offline full-text search, preprint lifecycle monitoring, and gene-disease relationship extraction. The only CLI that exposes Europe PMC's annotation API as structured commands.

quickstart.comment: Search Europe PMC and get structured JSON
Fetch full article metadata by PMID
Find papers that cite this article
Find papers with text-mined BRCA1 annotations
Get hit counts by source (PubMed, preprints, patents)

troubleshoots.symptom: Empty results for a query that works on europepmc.org
troubleshoots.fix: Europe PMC web uses automatic MeSH expansion; add --synonym true to your query

troubleshoots.symptom: Annotations endpoint returns empty for a PMID
troubleshoots.fix: Use SOURCE:ID format (e.g., MED:33024307), not bare PMID. Max 8 articles per request.
Only PMC articles with open access have full text. Use PMC ID format (e.g., PMC7537588), not PMID.
Check hitCount in response. If results < hitCount, use nextCursorMark for the next page.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you need to search biomedical literature across sources PubMed doesn't cover (preprints, European patents, UK theses), extract text-mined gene-disease-chemical relationships, track preprint-to-publication lifecycles, or build citation networks for systematic reviews.

recipes.title: Search for preprints on a topic
recipes.command: europe-pmc-pp-cli articles query --query "SRC:PPR AND semaglutide" --result-type core --agent --select resultList.result.title,resultList.result.doi,resultList.result.firstPublicationDate
recipes.explanation: Find bioRxiv/medRxiv preprints about semaglutide, returning only key fields

recipes.title: Find gene-disease co-occurrences
recipes.explanation: Find papers where BRCA1 and breast cancer are co-mentioned in text-mined annotations

recipes.title: Get citation graph for a paper
recipes.explanation: Build a one-hop citation network around a key paper

recipes.title: Check source breakdown for a query
recipes.explanation: See how many results come from PubMed vs preprints vs patents

recipes.title: Get database cross-links for an article
recipes.command: europe-pmc-pp-cli database-links list --source MED --id 33024307 --database UNIPROT --agent --select dbCrossReferenceList
recipes.explanation: Find UniProt protein entries linked to this paper
